To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the polymer electrolyte with the addition of lithium trifluoride salt showed high ionic conductivity and wide potential window which can be used for electric double-layer supercapacitor.
the electrical and electrochemical properties of the polymer electrolytes are significantly improved by increasing the salt content in the PVA polymer host.
the polymer electrolyte with high ionic conductivity can be prepared by solution casting method without any additives and can be used as an electrolyte for electric double-layer capacitors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of PVA–LiTf biopolymer electrolyte for EDLC application.
the fabrication of biopolymer electrolyte for electric double-layer capacitors application.
the development of a highly conducting polymer electrolyte and its application in EDLC cell.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PVA–LiTf polymer electrolyte is a promising electrolyte for EDLC application.
the prepared polymer electrolytes have potential to be applied as electrolytes in EDLC.
the polymer electrolyte with 40 wt % LiTf is the most suitable polymer electrolyte for EDLC application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the polymer electrolytes with high conductivity, good electrochemical stability, and high energy density can be obtained by the addition of ionic salt into biopolymer.
the prepared polymer electrolyte is a promising candidate for EDLC application.
PVA-based polymer electrolytes can be considered as promising electrolytes for EDLC application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can prepare highly conducting polymer electrolyte by using PVA and Li salts without using any plasticizer.
the polymer electrolytes are promising candidates for EDLC application.
the polymer electrolytes can be used in EDLC application with high capacitance and wide potential range.
